visual_action: Donald Trump is shown from the chest up at a podium, superimposed over a nighttime background from the video game Minecraft. His skin and suit are tinted green. He makes pained, coughing, and groaning motions. A pixelated Minecraft-style potion bottle icon briefly appears on his lapel.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is the sole person visually depicted in the video, and his face is confirmed by the provided face-ID.

spoken_summary: The audio consists of coughing, groaning, and gagging sounds layered over music. These sounds are reminiscent of the noises made by zombie characters in the video game Minecraft. There is no spoken dialogue.
audio_music: A calm, ambient electronic track, identified as 'Subwoofer Lullaby' by C418 from the Minecraft soundtrack, plays throughout the video. This contrasts with the grotesque zombie-like sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static shot with superimposed visual elements and text.
manipulation_or_satire: Donald Trump's image is visually altered: his skin and suit are colored green, and he is superimposed onto a background from the video game Minecraft to portray him as a zombie character. A pixelated Minecraft-style icon is also briefly superimposed on his suit.
central_claim: The video mocks Donald Trump by digitally altering his appearance to portray him as an undesirable zombie character in the video game Minecraft.
intended_effect: To amuse the viewer and encourage them to see Donald Trump in a negative and ridiculous light.
